description: Eval set for the Teja RAG chatbot (mock mode, no API key). Each question has a known correct answer and an expected source document, taken verbatim from the sample docs in data/sample_docs/. A question passes only when (a) every expected keyword appears in the answer text (accuracy) AND (b) the expected source is both returned as a source and cited in the answer text (citation correctness).
